availabilityMonitorBlock.title: Availability Monitor 1
availabilityMonitorBlock.description: A routing-aware service availability block with summary metrics, a 72-hour status strip, and a 24-hour comparison chart.
availabilityMonitorBlock.guidanceBody: Pass uptime and availability summaries, hourly timeline segments, and timestamped chart data from your monitoring API. The block keeps routing and direct-provider series independently inspectable while preserving semantic status colors and accessible summaries.
